page_title: ETI 0-2 MAR | St Etienne v Marseille 08/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+9' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90+7' Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Gautier Larsonneur comes off the line to clear the ball away.
90+6' The corner is swung in but Marseille can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
90+6' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
90+3' The game is interrupted.
90+2' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jonathan Rowe (Marseille) for Luis Henrique.
90+1' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to substitute Mason Greenwood and he is replaced by Lilian Brassier (Marseille).
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) comes onto the pitch for Pierre Ekwah.
89' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Marseille will have a chance to score from a corner.
87' Marseille failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

87' Elye Wahi (Marseille) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Gautier Larsonneur makes a great save. Marseille get a corner.
86' Marseille take a quick free kick with a short pass and play continues.
84' Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

81' Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jerome Brisard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
80' Marseille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
79' Roberto De Zerbi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alexi Koum Mbondo (Marseille) replacing Quentin Merlin.
79' Luis Henrique (Marseille) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
77' Ayman Aiki (St Etienne) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
75' Substitution. Louis Mouton makes way for Mathis Amougou (St Etienne).
73' Ayman Aiki (St Etienne) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Geronimo Rulli.
69' Roberto De Zerbi decides to make a substitution. Neal Maupay will be replaced by Derek Cornelius (Marseille).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Elye Wahi (Marseille) comes onto the pitch so that Valentin Rongier can be given a rest.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lucas Stassin will be replaced by Ayman Aiki (St Etienne).
66' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pierre Cornud trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne).
65' 0 - 2 Goal! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.
65' Gautier Larsonneur anticipates the direction of the penalty by Mason Greenwood (Marseille). He attempted to put the ball inside the left post, but the goalkeeper was there in time to deny him.
65' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is going to take the penalty!
64' St Etienne concede a free kick following a bad challenge. That is a penalty kick for Marseille.
63' The game is interrupted. Louis Mouton (St Etienne) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
60' Jerome Brisard interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Leo Petrot (St Etienne).
57' Louis Mouton (St Etienne) sends a cross into the box, but Geronimo Rulli comes off his line to gather the ball.
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Marseille.
52' Geoffrey Kondogbia (Marseille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
52' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
51' This shall not pass! Mason Greenwood (Marseille) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. Marseille have a corner.
50' There's an opportunity for Mason Greenwood (Marseille) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.

50' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom right corner. Gautier Larsonneur is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Marseille.

49' Neal Maupay (Marseille) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Gautier Larsonneur easily makes the save.
48' The resulting free kick from Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
47' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Valentin Rongier (Marseille) was quite harsh and Jerome Brisard didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Jerome Brisard blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Michael Murillo (Marseille) stands over the resultant free kick from mid-range, but his shot goes just over the crossbar. It could have been a fantastic goal!
45' Marseille have a free kick from a promising distance.
44' The referee blows his whistle as Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) was too aggressive in his challenge.
41' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) sends a long crossfield pass searching out one of his teammates, but his effort comes to nothing and they lose possession.
40' One of the St Etienne players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.
33' Neat passing move from St Etienne in order to create new attacking opportunities.
28' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

28' A sweet pass finds Quentin Merlin (Marseille) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Gautier Larsonneur is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. Corner kick. Marseille will have an opportunity.
28' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
27' Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Marseille earn a corner.
24' The Marseille players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' The ball is cleared after Neal Maupay (Marseille) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
18' 0 - 1 It's 0:1! Neal Maupay feeds Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) inside the box, who is unmarked and buries the ball in the right side of the net.
18' Referee Jerome Brisard signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Marseille players have a reason to celebrate!
18' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Jerome Brisard wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
17' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Adrien Rabiot (Marseille) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
15' Leonardo Balerdi (Marseille) sends a long ball in, but Gautier Larsonneur comfortably gathers the ball.
11' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

10' What a great touch by Quentin Merlin (Marseille) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. Good work from Marseille as they win a corner.
9' Mason Greenwood (Marseille) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just over the bar.
6' It looks like Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) saw red with that tackle. Jerome Brisard won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
5' The keeper makes a simple save after Mason Greenwood (Marseille) received a short pass and shot low from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal.

4' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Geronimo Rulli is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
3' Michael Murillo (Marseille) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
2' Marseille enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Marseille will kick the game off.
Jerome Brisard was nominated as the referee for this game.
